server {
  server_name gemini;
  listen %s;

  default_type 'application/json';

  location = "/v1/chat/completions/good-with-multimodal-tokens" {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local json    = require "cjson.safe"
      local token   = ngx.req.get_headers()["authorization"]
      local api_key = ngx.req.get_headers()["x-goog-api-key"]
      if not (token == "Bearer gemini-key" or api_key == "123") then
        ngx.status = 401
        return
      end
      ngx.req.read_body()
      local body = json.decode(ngx.req.get_body_data() or "{}")
      if body and body.stream then
        local chunks = {
          '[',
          '{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"The image "}]} }],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":1124,"candidatesTokenCount":12,"totalTokenCount":1136,"cachedContentTokenCount":512,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":1000},{"modality":"IMAGE","tokenCount":124}],"cacheTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":500},{"modality":"IMAGE","tokenCount":12}],"candidatesTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":12}]},"modelVersion":"gemini-2.5-flash"},',
          '{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"shows a cat."}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":1124,"candidatesTokenCount":12,"totalTokenCount":1136,"cachedContentTokenCount":512,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":1000},{"modality":"IMAGE","tokenCount":124}],"cacheTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":500},{"modality":"IMAGE","tokenCount":12}],"candidatesTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":12}]},"modelVersion":"gemini-2.5-flash"}',
          ']',
        }
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        for _, chunk in ipairs(chunks) do
          ngx.print(chunk)
          ngx.flush(true)
          ngx.sleep(0.01)
        end
      else
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.print(pl_file.read("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/good-with-multimodal-tokens.json"))
      end
    }
  }

  location = "/v1/chat/completions/good-with-cached-tokens" {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local json    = require "cjson.safe"
      local token   = ngx.req.get_headers()["authorization"]
      local api_key = ngx.req.get_headers()["x-goog-api-key"]
      if not (token == "Bearer gemini-key" or api_key == "123") then
        ngx.status = 401
        return
      end
      ngx.req.read_body()
      local body = json.decode(ngx.req.get_body_data() or "{}")
      if body and body.stream then
        -- Gemini streaming: send individual JSON objects separated by '[' / ']'
        -- wrappers (mirroring the Gemini API format).  The Gemini driver decodes
        -- each inner object as a standalone chunk.
        local chunks = {
          '[',
          '{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"2"}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":1024,"candidatesTokenCount":12,"totalTokenCount":1036,"cachedContentTokenCount":512}}',
          ']',
        }
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        for _, chunk in ipairs(chunks) do
          ngx.print(chunk)
          ngx.flush(true)
          ngx.sleep(0.01)
        end
      else
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.print(pl_file.read("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/good-with-cached-tokens.json"))
      end
    }
  }

  location ~ ^/v1/chat/completions/websearch {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local test_models = require "spec.helpers.ai.test_models"
      local json = require("cjson.safe")

      local token = ngx.req.get_headers()["authorization"]
      if token == "Bearer gemini-key" then
        ngx.req.read_body()
        local body, err = ngx.req.get_body_data()
        body, err = json.decode(body)

        if body and body.stream then
          -- grounding metadata arrives with the final content chunk, mirroring real Gemini behaviour
          local event_chunks = {
            '[',
            '{"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": "The Eiffel Tower is in Paris."}], "role": "model"}, "index": 0}]}',
            ',',
            '{"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": " It was completed in 1889."}]}, "finishReason": "STOP", "index": 0, "groundingMetadata": {"groundingChunks": [{"web": {"uri": "https://example.com/eiffel-tower", "title": "Eiffel Tower - Wikipedia"}}, {"web": {"uri": "https://example.com/paris-landmarks", "title": "Paris Landmarks"}}], "groundingSupports": [{"segment": {"startIndex": 0, "endIndex": 27}, "groundingChunkIndices": [0]}, {"segment": {"startIndex": 29, "endIndex": 56}, "groundingChunkIndices": [1, 0]}]}}]}',
            ']',
          }

          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"

          for _, event in ipairs(event_chunks) do
            ngx.print(event)
            ngx.flush(true)
            ngx.sleep(0.01)
          end

        else
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(test_models.read_fixture("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/good-websearch.json"))
        end
      end
    }
  }

  location ~ ^/v1/chat/completions/query-auth {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local json = require("cjson.safe")

      -- Check for query parameter authentication
      local args = ngx.req.get_uri_args()
      if args.key == "gemini-query-key" then
        ngx.req.read_body()
        local body, err = ngx.req.get_body_data()
        body, err = json.decode(body)

        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.print(pl_file.read("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/good.json"))
      else
        ngx.status = 401
        ngx.print('{"error": "Unauthorized"}')
      end
    }
  }

  location ~ ^/v1/chat/completions {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local json = require("cjson.safe")
      local capture_path = "%s"
      local test_models = require "spec.helpers.ai.test_models"

      local token = ngx.req.get_headers()["authorization"]
      local api_key = ngx.req.get_headers()["x-goog-api-key"]
      if token == "Bearer gemini-key" or api_key == "123" then
        ngx.req.read_body()
        local body, err = ngx.req.get_body_data()
        body, err = json.decode(body)
        local generation_config = body.generationConfig or {}
        local thinking_config = generation_config.thinkingConfig or {}
        if capture_path ~= "" then
          pl_file.write(capture_path, json.encode({
            -- For Gemini 3+
            thinking_level = thinking_config.thinkingLevel,
            -- For Gemini 2.5
            thinking_budget = thinking_config.thinkingBudget,
            include_thoughts = thinking_config.includeThoughts,
            stream = body.stream,
          }))
        end

        if body.stream then
          local event_chunks = {
            '[',
            '{"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": "2"}], "role": "model"}, "finishReason": "STOP", "index": 0}]}',
            ']',
          }

          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"

          for _, event in ipairs(event_chunks) do
            ngx.print(event)
            ngx.flush(true)
            ngx.sleep(0.01)
          end
        else
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(test_models.read_fixture("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/good.json"))
        end
      end
    }
  }

  location = "/v1/chat/completions/logprobs/stream" {

  # native mode response carrying cache token metadata
  location ~ ^/v1beta/models/gemini-cache-probe:[^/]+ {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local token = ngx.req.get_headers()["authorization"]
      if token ~= "Bearer gemini-key" then
        ngx.status = 401
        ngx.print('{"error": "Unauthorized"}')
        return
      end
      ngx.req.read_body()
      ngx.status = 200
      if ngx.var.uri:find("streamGenerateContent", 1, true) then
        local usage = '{"promptTokenCount":1124,"candidatesTokenCount":12,"totalTokenCount":1136,"cachedContentTokenCount":512,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":1000},{"modality":"IMAGE","tokenCount":124}],"cacheTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":500},{"modality":"IMAGE","tokenCount":12}],"candidatesTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":12}]}'
        local chunks = {
          '[',
          '{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"The image "}]} }],"usageMetadata":' .. usage .. ',"modelVersion":"gemini-2.5-flash"},',
          '{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"shows a cat."}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"usageMetadata":' .. usage .. ',"modelVersion":"gemini-2.5-flash"}',
          ']',
        }
        ngx.header["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        for _, chunk in ipairs(chunks) do
          ngx.print(chunk)
          ngx.flush(true)
          ngx.sleep(0.01)
        end
      else
        ngx.print(pl_file.read("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/good-with-multimodal-tokens.json"))
      end
    }
  }

  # /v1/messages native mode without custom upstream url
  location ~ ^/v1beta/models/[^/]+:[^/]+ {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local json = require("cjson.safe")
      local uri = ngx.var.uri
      local method = ngx.req.get_method()
  
      local token = ngx.req.get_headers()["authorization"]
      if token ~= "Bearer gemini-key" then
        ngx.status = 401
        ngx.print('{"error": "Unauthorized"}')
        return
      end
  
      if method == "POST" and uri:match('/models/([%%w%%.%%-]+):batchGenerateContent$') then
        -- create batch
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.print(pl_file.read("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/batches/created.json"))
        return
      end
  
      ngx.req.read_body()
      local body, err = ngx.req.get_body_data()
      body, err = json.decode(body)
  
      ngx.status = 200
      ngx.print(pl_file.read("spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/llm-v1-chat/responses/native-good.json"))
    }
  }

  location ~ ^/v1/ {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local cjson = require "cjson.safe"
      local method = ngx.req.get_method()
      local uri = ngx.var.uri

      local batch_name = "projects/432057123508/locations/us-central1/batchPredictionJobs/2037446585876480"
      local model_name = "publishers/google/models/gemini-2.5-pro"
      local inputConfig = {
        instancesFormat = "jsonl",
        gcsSource = {
          uris = {"gs://aigw-test/vertex_batch_file.jsonl"}
        }
      }

      local outputConfig = {
        predictionsFormat = 'jsonl',
        gcsDestination = { outputUriPrefix = 'gs://aigw-test/',},
      }

      local list_resp = cjson.encode({
        batchPredictionJobs = {
          { name = batch_name, displayName = batch_name, inputConfig = inputConfig, outputConfig = outputConfig },
        },
      })

      local create_or_get_resp = cjson.encode({ name = batch_name, })

      local delete_resp = cjson.encode({ name = "operation" })

      local method = ngx.req.get_method()
      if uri:match("/v1/projects/[^/]+/locations/[^/]+/batchPredictionJobs$") then
        -- list
        if method == "GET" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(list_resp)

        -- create
        elseif method == "POST" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(create_or_get_resp)
        end

      elseif uri:match("/v1/projects/[^/]+/locations/[^/]+/batchPredictionJobs/[^/]+:cancel$") then
        -- cancel
        ngx.status = 200
        ngx.print("{}")

      elseif uri:match("/v1/projects/[^/]+/locations/[^/]+/batchPredictionJobs/[^/]+$") then
        -- delete
        if method == "DELETE" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(delete_resp)

        -- get
        elseif method == "GET" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(create_or_get_resp)
        end

      else
        ngx.status = 400
      end
    }
  }

  # gemini batches custom upstream url endpoint
  location ~ ^/custom/batches/v1beta/ {
    content_by_lua_block {
      local pl_file = require "pl.file"
      local method = ngx.req.get_method()
      local uri = ngx.var.uri

      local path
      local match = true
      if method == "GET" then
        if uri:match('/batches$') then
          -- list
          path = "spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/batches/list.json"

        elseif uri:match('/batches/([%%w]+)$') then
          -- get
          path = "spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/batches/get.json"

        else match = false
        end

      elseif method == "POST" then
        if uri:match('/models/([%%w%%.%%-]+):batchGenerateContent$') then
          -- create
          path = "spec/fixtures/ai-proxy/gemini/batches/created.json"

        elseif uri:match('/batches/([%%w]+):cancel$') then
          -- cancel
          match = true

        else
          match = false
        end

      elseif method == "DELETE" then
        if not uri:match('/batches/([%%w]+)$') then
          -- DELETE
          match = false
        end

      else match = false
      end

      if match then
        ngx.status = 200
        if path then
          ngx.print(pl_file.read(path))

        else ngx.print("{}")
        end

      else
        ngx.status = 404
      end

      return
    }
  }

          -- cancel

        else

        end

      elseif method == "DELETE" then
        if not uri:match('/batches/([%%w]+)$') then
          -- DELETE

        end
      
      else match = false
      end

      local outputConfig = {
        predictionsFormat = 'jsonl',
        gcsDestination = { outputUriPrefix = 'gs://aigw-test/',},
      }

      local list_resp = cjson.encode({
        batchPredictionJobs = {
          { name = batch_name, displayName = batch_name, inputConfig = inputConfig, outputConfig = outputConfig },
        },
      })

      local create_or_get_resp = cjson.encode({ name = batch_name, })

      local delete_resp = cjson.encode({ name = "operation" })

      local method = ngx.req.get_method()
      if uri:match("/v1/projects/[^/]+/locations/[^/]+/batchPredictionJobs$") then
        -- list
        if method == "GET" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(list_resp)

        -- create
        elseif method == "POST" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(create_or_get_resp)
        end

      elseif uri:match("/v1/projects/[^/]+/locations/[^/]+/batchPredictionJobs/[^/]+:cancel$") then
        -- cancel
        ngx.status = 200

      elseif uri:match("/v1/projects/[^/]+/locations/[^/]+/batchPredictionJobs/[^/]+$") then
        -- delete
        if method == "DELETE" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(delete_resp)

        -- get
        elseif method == "GET" then
          ngx.status = 200
          ngx.print(create_or_get_resp)
        end

      else
        ngx.status = 400
      end
    }
  }
}
